case_policy: Independent authored fixtures. Active red tests; no xfail, deletion or silent exclusion from full-suite claims. No real data, model, credentials or rendering.

cases.truth_source: Task explicitly requires aggregation/chart/format; blank workbook has none.
cases.minimal_input: Blank xlsx plus rich task with absent constraints.
cases.expected: No full task acceptance; structural-only or spec-incomplete is acceptable.
cases.evidence: observation.json is written before the contract assertion

cases.truth_source: Independent paragraph indexing: required paragraph 2 contains unrelated text.
cases.minimal_input: Two-paragraph docx; target appears only in paragraph 1.
cases.evidence: observation.json is written before the contract assertion

cases.truth_source: Textbox left coordinate exceeds slide width; task requires visible delivery.
cases.minimal_input: Single slide with required text entirely outside the canvas.
cases.expected: Do not publish full visible-delivery PASS from text-only evidence; a spec/assessment gap is acceptable.
cases.evidence: observation.json is written before the contract assertion

cases.truth_source: A later solid opaque foreground rectangle fully contains the required textbox.
cases.minimal_input: Text and fully containing opaque cover; no rendering or model judgment.
cases.expected: Do not infer visual clearance from containment alone; review is acceptable.
cases.evidence: observation.json is written before the contract assertion

cases.truth_source: a+b equals sum([a,b]) for each independently specified variant; task permits equivalent sums.

cases.expected: Validate equivalent formula or declare gap; do not reject solely for SUM syntax.
cases.evidence: observation.json is written before the contract assertion

cases.truth_source: Known champion instruction sentinel must appear in the captured request.

cases.truth_source: Authored stub writes wrong first docx and correct second docx if called again.
